snippet.title: Orbital Drift – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🚀 Wishlist Orbital Drift on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4669550/Orbital_Drift/

⭐ Every wishlist helps our small indie team!

Orbital Drift is a sci-fi adventure set in the low orbit of a long-dead world.

Explore abandoned stations, drifting wrecks, and the remains of an extinct civilization. Master realistic orbital mechanics, navigate in zero gravity, recover lost technology, and uncover the mystery behind the downfall of an entire species.

Features:
• Realistic orbital movement and space navigation
• Zero-gravity exploration
• Abandoned stations and drifting wrecks
• Resource gathering and ship upgrades
• Environmental storytelling and mystery
• A unique sci-fi world waiting to be discovered

Developed by a small indie team, Orbital Drift is currently in active development.

Follow our journey:
🌐 https://orbitaldriftgame.com
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/w4jxXs6pFe
